categories.name: Geography & Environmental Studies
categories.description: Human and physical geography, environmental studies, and planning programs examining how people, places, and ecosystems interact — from GIS and spatial analysis to conservation and urban planning.

tips.title: Volunteer in local conservation
tips.detail: Sustained stewardship work — tree plantings, stream cleanups, invasive-species pulls with a conservation authority, park friends group, or naturalist club — is concrete evidence of environmental commitment and produces specific stories for supplementary applications.

tips.title: Build a mapping project with open data
tips.detail: Free tools like QGIS and municipal open-data portals make it possible to map something you care about — transit access, tree cover, flood risk — in a weekend. A finished map or story map is a portfolio piece few applicants can show.

tips.title: Take on outdoor leadership
tips.detail: The Duke of Edinburgh's Award, Scouts, cadets, camp counselling, and school outdoor or eco clubs all combine fieldwork comfort with leadership — exactly the mix geography and environment programs like to see.

programs.name: Geography & Planning
programs.notes: Entry is through the Faculty of Arts & Science's Social Sciences admission category; geography and planning programs of study are declared after first year.

tips.title: OUAC application deadline
tips.detail: Apply through OUAC by January 15, 2027 — the equal-consideration date for Fall 2027 entry to Ontario universities.

tips.title: President's/entrance scholar consideration
tips.detail: Admitted students with averages of roughly 92% and above are automatically considered for University of Toronto entrance scholarships, including President's Scholars awards.

programs.name: Geography and Environmental Management
programs.notes: Offered by Waterloo's Faculty of Environment with optional co-op; specializations include Geomatics and Climate Change.

supplementary.name: Admission Information Form (AIF)
supplementary.description: Waterloo's supplementary form covering activities, interests, and circumstances; scored and factored into admission decisions.

tips.title: Make the AIF count
tips.detail: The Admission Information Form can meaningfully boost a borderline average. Mapping projects, conservation volunteering, and outdoor leadership roles are exactly the specifics Waterloo's Faculty of Environment looks for.

tips.title: OUAC application deadline
tips.detail: Apply through OUAC by January 15, 2027 — the equal-consideration date for Fall 2027 entry to Ontario universities.

tips.title: President's Scholarship of Distinction
tips.detail: Automatic consideration by admission average: 95%+ earns the President's Scholarship of Distinction, 90–94.9% the President's Scholarship, and 85–89.9% the Merit Scholarship.

programs.name: Planning
programs.notes: Professionally accredited honours planning degree with co-op; one of the most competitive routes into urban planning in Canada, with successful applicants typically above the published minimum.

supplementary.name: Admission Information Form (AIF)
supplementary.description: Waterloo's supplementary form covering activities, interests, and circumstances; scored and factored into admission decisions.

tips.title: Make the AIF count
tips.detail: Planning is a small, competitive cohort, so the Admission Information Form matters for borderline averages. Point at concrete civic interests — municipal open-data projects, youth councils, community consultations you attended — rather than general enthusiasm for cities.

tips.title: OUAC application deadline
tips.detail: Apply through OUAC by January 15, 2027 — the equal-consideration date for Fall 2027 entry to Ontario universities.

tips.title: President's Scholarship of Distinction
tips.detail: Automatic consideration by admission average: 95%+ earns the President's Scholarship of Distinction, 90–94.9% the President's Scholarship, and 85–89.9% the Merit Scholarship.

programs.name: Geography
programs.notes: UBC admission is broad-based: grades plus the Personal Profile. Entry is through the Faculty of Arts, and geography majors — human and environmental streams — are declared after first year. The BC equivalent of the listed course is English Studies 12.

supplementary.name: Personal Profile
supplementary.description: Short written responses about experiences, activities, and what you learned from them; weighted alongside grades for all direct-entry UBC applicants.

tips.title: Take the Personal Profile seriously
tips.detail: The Personal Profile is weighted alongside your marks. Conservation volunteering, mapping projects, and outdoor leadership give geography applicants specific stories — describe what you did and what it taught you.

tips.title: UBC application deadline
tips.detail: Apply through EducationPlannerBC by January 15, 2027 for September 2027 entry. Verify the current cycle's dates on UBC's admissions site before relying on them.

tips.title: Major entrance awards are profile-based
tips.detail: UBC's major entrance awards, including Presidential Scholars Awards, are selected from the application and Personal Profile rather than an automatic average cutoff; some require a separate application.

programs.name: Human Geography
programs.notes: Requirements shown use Ontario 4U codes; Alberta applicants present ELA 30-1 and four other 30-level academic courses. Offered through the Faculty of Arts, with a related BA in Planning available.

tips.title: ApplyAlberta application deadline
tips.detail: Apply through ApplyAlberta by March 1, 2027 for most Fall 2027 programs. Deadlines vary by program and competitive programs can close earlier — verify the current cycle's dates on the UAlberta admissions site.

tips.title: UAlberta admission-based entrance scholarships
tips.detail: UAlberta automatically considers applicants for entrance scholarships based on admission average, with awards generally starting around 80% and increasing at higher averages.

tips.title: ApplyAlberta application deadline

tips.title: UCalgary automatic entrance awards
tips.detail: UCalgary automatically considers applicants for admission-average-based entrance awards, with most automatic awards starting around an 85% admission average. Verify current thresholds on UCalgary's awards pages.

programs.name: Geography

tips.title: USask application deadline
tips.detail: Apply by February 15, 2027 for most direct-entry Fall 2027 programs. Verify the current cycle's deadline for your program on the USask admissions site.

tips.title: USask Guaranteed Entrance Scholarships
tips.detail: USask awards Guaranteed Entrance Scholarships automatically by admission average, with tiers starting at 80% and larger awards at 85% and 90%. Verify current values on USask's scholarship pages.

programs.name: Geography
programs.notes: Memorial's tuition is among the lowest of any Canadian university, particularly for students from Newfoundland and Labrador.

tips.title: Rolling admission — apply by early spring
tips.detail: Memorial reviews applications on a rolling basis rather than against a single equal-consideration date. Applying by early spring — ideally before March — is advised for the best access to program seats, residence, and entrance award consideration.
